_about: Self-test set for the Legixo Q&A API. 30 cases over a 30-file / 93-chunk corpus: 20 single-source, 4 multi-source, 6 out-of-corpus. Facts transcribed from corpus/. Run with: python -m scripts.run_eval
_matching: expected_contains items are matched after normalisation (lowercase; markdown, currency, comma/space digit grouping and hyphens collapsed). A string item must appear; a list item is satisfied if ANY variant appears. expected_sources = ALL must be cited. expected_sources_any = at least one must be cited (for facts stated in more than one document).
_distractors: The corpus deliberately contains three employment agreements with different notice periods (Bluecrest 60d, Vantage 30d, Meridian 90d) and three leases with different units/deposits. Answering correctly requires picking the right document, not just the right topic.

cases.question: What is the notice period in the Bluecrest employment agreement?
cases.notes: DISTRACTOR TEST: two other employment agreements state 30 and 90 days.

cases.question: How long is the non-compete at Bluecrest and what limits it?
cases.notes: Multi-part answer from one section.

cases.question: When is mediation mandatory before trial, and how long must it last?

cases.question: What is the security deposit for Unit 4B and when is it refundable?

cases.question: What time is case CV-2024-8812 listed, and what percentage of open invoices did Northfield offer to settle?
cases.notes: MULTI-SOURCE: must cite both the hearing notice and the counsel notes. Original wording asked for the 'settlement posture', which the model fairly answered with the client's 85% counter rather than Northfield's 70% offer - the question was ambiguous, so it now names the figure it wants.
